description: Migrate a medium-traffic SaaS database from MySQL 8.0 to PostgreSQL 16. The database is 200GB with 120 tables. The migration must follow this sequence: set up a replication bridge (MySQL binlog to Postgres via pgloader or DMS), perform schema diff and conversion (AUTO_INCREMENT to SERIAL, ENUM types, ENGINE=InnoDB assumptions), run a dual-write period (application writes to both databases), run reconciliation (row counts, checksum), and execute cutover with CHECK constraint exposure (Postgres CHECK constraints that MySQL ignored must now be validated against existing data). A rollback plan must exist (fail back to MySQL, replay writes). Risk factors: MySQL-specific SQL (backtick quoting, implicit casts), replication lag, and data that violates new Postgres CHECK constraints. Tools available: pgloader, AWS DMS, pgAdmin, mysql, psql, feature flags.
